title: Output summary under appending a bit
statement: For any Boolean list $u$ and optional Boolean symbol $o$, the summary of the output obtained by appending $o$ to $u$ is the update of the summary of $u$ by $o$. Here the three summaries distinguish an empty output, the output consisting exactly of the single bit $1$, and every other output.
